title: The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface
abstract: arXiv:2609.36118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies connect a pretrained vision-language backbone to an action head through a latent interface, but which backbone layers this interface should expose remains unclear. We study single-layer selection and multi-layer fusion for frozen backbones across three pretrained models and two manipulation benchmarks, LIBERO and CALVIN, with three policy-training seeds per configuration. Across three fusion mechanisms and three layer-subset strategies, 47 of 54 configurations underperform the best observed single-layer policy. Our stastical analysis further confirms that fusion's advantage is very limited. However, the best layer varies substantially across backbones and benchmarks, making layer selection consequential and exhaustive policy sweeps expensive. translated_title: VLA的层之谜：VLA潜在接口的信息论分析
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过一个潜在接口将预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络与动作头连接起来，但该接口应暴露骨干网络的哪些层仍然不明确。我们在三个预训练模型和两个操作基准（LIBERO和CALVIN）上，针对冻结的骨干网络研究了单层选择与多层融合，每种配置使用三个策略训练随机种子。在三种融合机制和三种层子集策略下，54种配置中有47种的表现不如观察到的最佳单层策略。我们的统计分析进一步证实了融合的优势非常有限。然而，最佳层在不同的骨干网络和基准之间变化很大，这使得层选择变得至关重要，而穷举式的策略扫描成本高昂。我们进一步推导了所提出的动作条件InfoNCE与动作预测的信息瓶颈目标之间的重加权等价性，并因此提出了……
tldr: 该论文通过信息论分析揭示VLA模型潜在接口的“层之谜”：多层融合在绝大多数配置下并不优于最佳单层策略，但最佳层因骨干网络和任务而异，并推导出动作条件InfoNCE与动作预测信息瓶颈目标之间的重加权等价性以指导层选择。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the "layer mystery" of VLA latent interfaces through information-theoretical analysis, showing that multi-layer fusion underperforms the best single-layer policy in 47 of 54 configurations while the optimal layer varies across backbones and benchmarks, and derives a reweighting equivalence between information-bottleneck objectives of action-conditioned InfoNCE and action prediction to guide layer selection.
